paraphrase: Perversions of perception, thought and view — taking the impermanent as permanent, the painful as pleasant, the not-self as self, the foul as beautiful — are removed by insight into the three characteristics.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
